concern: Urdu دکھا دیں (past tense "showed", agreeing with plural fem nishaaniyan) is romanised "dikha din"; din reads as the noun "day" (دن). Same collision the owner ruled on at 45:17 (Q21): dein is correct here.
suggestion: Hum ne use apni sab nishaaniyan dikha dein, lekin phir bhi is ne jhutlaaya aur inkaar kar diya.

concern: Urdu ہلاک کر دیتے is the conditional/habitual plural ("would have destroyed", matching hum and the sentence's other conditional verbs keh uthte / karte / hote). Roman "karde" drops the -te ending, reading as the imperative/simple "kar de" instead of the conditional "kar dete".
suggestion: Aur agar hum is se pehle hi unhein azaab se halaak kar dete to yaqeenan yeh keh uthte ke aye hamare parwardigar tu ne hamare paas apna Rasool kyun na bheja? Ke hum teri aayaton ki tabedaari karte is se pehle ke hum zaleel-o-ruswa hote.
